mapper.select: SELECT t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transaction t JOIN category c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_type = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(t.txn_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY t.category_id, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC
